facts.text: Tim is a fan of the fantasy genre, particularly enjoying epic adventures and magical worlds.

evidence.quote: I'm a huge fan of this genre! Epic adventures and magical worlds are my thing.

facts.text: Tim shared a photo of a poster for the movie 'Lord of the Rings', which he described as his favorite.

evidence.quote: Here's a pic of my favorite, Lord of the Rings!

facts.text: Tim is excited about a new fantasy TV series called 'The Wheel of Time', which is based on a book series he loves.

evidence.quote: I'm really excited to watch this new show that's coming out called 'The Wheel of Time'. It's based on a book series that I love.

facts.text: Tim mentioned that the new fantasy TV series 'The Wheel of Time' is set to release next month.

evidence.quote: There's a new fantasy TV series coming out next month - can't wait!
